description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Dashboard' that provides a high-level overview of Kanban data such as status counts, assignee summaries, and column summaries. It uses React hooks like useMemo and useCallback, and consumes context from 'useKanban' to display live data in a dashboard layout.

methods.name: Dashboard()
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a dashboard overview for Kanban data.

methods.name: normalizeStatus
methods.description: Normalizes raw status strings to canonical labels used within the dashboard, such as 'In Progress', 'Review', 'On Hold', 'Done', or 'To do'.
